title: ADR-007: Retry policy for bank settlement calls
text:
Context: AcmeBank's settlement API returns intermittent 502s during their batch window.
Decision: retry settlement calls up to 5 times with exponential backoff (1, 2, 4, 8, 16 minutes).
Consequences: covers ~99% of transient failures seen in February.
